Kimberly — reviewed the CSV and added commentary. Key items to share back to CureWell:

- KMS posture: Hosted: AWS KMS (multi-region CMKs) used for tenant envelope keys; Dedicated/Private customers can integrate customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS or HSMs via Vault). We maintain customer key separation and rotate CMKs per policy.
- Attestations: We have current SOC 2 Type II reports for 2024–2025 available on request; attached is a short cert summary for our critical vendors.
- High-risk notes: two smaller analytics vendors in the list are not SOC 2 certified. Mitigation: contracts include data minimization clauses, processor-only access, scoped encryption-at-rest, limited access logging, quarterly vendor reviews — see suggested mitigation language in the attached.

Attachments: kms_cert_summary_2025.pdf (PDF, 450KB), thirdparty_dependency_graph.png (PNG, 240KB)

I recommend we provide CureWell: the inventory CSV, the cert summary, a one-page mitigation matrix (I can draft), and a short architecture diagram that highlights where subprocessors touch customer data. If they want deeper evidence, we can share redacted contracts under an NDA.

If you want me on the call Thursday, I can join 9–11am PT.
